csv_project_name: Consultant for Aerial Roofing & Pavement Assessment
csv_scope_of_work: MnDOT seeks a Contractor to perform aerial infrared thermography and high-resolution visual imagery assessments to identify moisture intrusion, quantify anomalies, and provide actionable, portfolio-level roof and pavement condition data. Primary objectives include detection and prioritization of subsurface moisture anomalies, generation of blended infrared and visual imagery panels, and development of site-specific and portfolio-level reports that support capital planning.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning

title: Consultant for Aerial Roofing & Pavement Assessment
short_description: Aerial infrared and visual assessment of roofs and pavements for condition reporting.
project_scope: A consulting assignment for aerial infrared thermography and high-resolution visual imagery assessments of building roofs and pavements. The work includes identifying moisture intrusion, quantifying anomalies, detecting and prioritizing subsurface moisture anomalies, generating blended infrared and visual imagery panels, and preparing site-specific and portfolio-level condition reports to support capital planning. No building sizes, roof areas, pavement areas, or structural spans are stated.
services: Aerial infrared thermography, high-resolution visual imagery acquisition, condition assessment, anomaly detection and prioritization, reporting, and portfolio-level asset assessment support.
relevance_explanation:
- Not a structural design or planning tender for bridges, buildings, roofs, or special structures.
- Focus is on condition assessment, thermography, imagery, and asset reporting.
- Disciplines include surveying/GIS, construction/project management, and planning rather than structural engineering.
- Explicitly outside sbp core target areas such as bridge design, long-span structures, or complex building structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for assessment and reporting services only, with no defined construction measure, roof replacement scope, pavement rehabilitation quantity, or capital budget from which a realistic construction cost could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget is stated in the notice. The procurement concerns consulting services for aerial assessment and reporting; without scope quantities such as number of sites, roof area, pavement area, flight extent, or expected staffing, no reliable fee estimate is possible.
contracting_authority: State of Minnesota, Minnesota Department of Transportation (MnDOT), Saint Paul, Minnesota, USA. Contact: Daniel Duffy, daniel.duffy@state.mn.us, phone 952-208-3218. Questions contact: Chris Moates, chris.moates@state.mn.us. Website: https://www.dot.state.mn.us/consult/notices.html
notes: Project #: 863546. Agency ID: 33453. Project Number: 1063035. ProjectID: 1005868. Target market: General Building. Contract duration: base period 24 months with 36-month renewal option; renewable. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Questions deadline: 05/27/2026 02:00 PM CDT.
